display_long_description:
La Pandora’s Box surrounds you with music, myth, and live performance in a 43-minute immersive motion-picture concert filmed in 12K RAW, true 360° VR.

Journey through a mythic world of creation, temptation, chaos, and redemption, where music becomes environment, performance becomes story, and every visual transition unfolds around you in 360 degrees. 
[media]
Guided by an original cinematic score, La Pandora’s Box places you at the center of a surreal odyssey through cosmic dreamscapes, fractured corridors, crimson sanctuaries, submerged cities, and luminous realms of rebirth.

[media]
Created by multi-award-winning director, composer, producer, and engineer Nadeem Majdalany, La Pandora’s Box fuses cinematic storytelling, spatial sound design, live musical performance, and surreal world-building into a singular VR experience. Real musicians, dancers, and performers are composited into immersive virtual environments, while narration by Bronson Pinchot and Courtney Friel and immersive audio mixed by 7x Grammy-winning mix engineer Brian Vibberts help shape a concert film that surrounds the viewer rather than unfolding on a distant screen. 

[media]
From the opening Birth of the Universe sequence to the moment Pandora’s Box fractures the world around you, **La Pandora’s Box** is a cinematic passage through sound, memory, temptation, destruction, and hope. It is a VR experience for music lovers, film audiences, art seekers, and anyone drawn to new forms of immersive storytelling.
